items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Leonard Goldberg let me have a thousand dollars.

ctx.x: He's the only one that didn't ask me for the other side, didn't let him have none. Robert ran one in $40. Come back just about a day before we're gonna leave, one in $40 more. Uh-huh. Well, I couldn't go no further. Oh, uh, uh, uh, Leonard Goldberg let me have a thousand dollars. He involved my thousand was right at, at the end of the road. Uh-huh. So we had three automobiles. We had a Model T, which was offered, and my, uh, my convertible Chrysler, and, uh, uh,

Jack had this convertible Dodge open, what do you call them, Touring Corps. And we left there and we went all the way to Dallas in that transportation. Bucks Cottrell was Arthur's buddy and friend, so he rode with his big fat self next to a little bit of Arthur during the, in a mile of T-fold.
